about.title: Corning Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Corning sits along a stretch of Interstate 5 that carries steady through-traffic in and out of Tehama County, and local roads like Marguerite Avenue see their own share of daily activity. Public safety records show collisions here tend to cluster in the early morning hours on Fridays, often tied to fatigue, reduced visibility, or shift-change traffic. Whatever the cause, dealing with an insurance adjuster while you're still sorting out medical care and vehicle repairs can be overwhelming. LawProactive is a free service that connects Corning residents with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened, explain your options under California law, and handle communications with insurers on your behalf. There's no fee unless the attorney recovers compensation for you. We're not a law firm ourselves — just a bridge to one that fits your situation.

whyChoose.title: What to Know Before You Speak With an Insurer

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date of a Corning car accident to file a personal injury claim, though that window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity — like a public road maintenance agency — is involved. Acting early helps preserve your options.

items.title: Comparative Fault Won't Shut You Out
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, so even if you're partly responsible for a crash on I-5 or a local road, you can still recover a share of damages tied to the other driver's fault percentage.

items.title: Recorded Statements Can Work Against You
items.desc: Insurance adjusters often ask for a recorded statement soon after a crash — before you know the full extent of your injuries. An independent attorney can advise you on what to say and preserve evidence like crash scene photos or witness details before they disappear.

items.question: Do I have to pay anything upfront to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free connection service, and attorneys in our network work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no cost to you to get matched or to have your case reviewed.

items.question: What if my accident happened on I-5 near Corning and I'm not sure who was at fault?
items.answer: That's common, especially with multi-vehicle crashes on a corridor like I-5. An independent attorney can help gather evidence, such as police reports and traffic camera footage where available, to sort out fault under California's comparative fault rules.

items.question: How long do I have to file a claim after a car accident in Corning?
items.answer: Generally, California gives you two years from the accident date to file a personal injury lawsuit. If a government entity, such as one responsible for road conditions on a street like Marguerite Avenue, may be involved, that deadline can be as short as six months, so it's worth getting guidance quickly.
